nodes.label: Added (scope 003): the journal format (one SQLite file), the bootstrap rules and the contract of every control and session record, written down in spec 0003 and built by later scopes; nothing reads or writes a journal in this build
Added (scope 003): ten glossary terms, among them Node, Journal, Authority ID, Bootstrap, Restore hold and Conflict latch

Added (scope 003): an exact identity map lookup in pool-config, ValidatedConfig::resolve_identity; a pair that is not written in the file gets no route; no wildcard and no default entry (0001 SC-3, SEC-2)

Added (scope 003): a fourth form of the finding line for a finding inside a repeated table, naming the key and the place, for example 'config.duplicate_id at node.id, line 18, column 6'; the JSON finding has key, line and column all set

Added (scope 003): six finding codes for the new keys: config.invalid_value, duplicate_id, unknown_reference, duplicate_endpoint, duplicate_identity and unsupported_value; routing_profile = replica is refused with the last one
Added (scope 003): thirteen new configuration fixtures, which brings the set to twenty eight

Added (scope 003): configuration keys for clusters, nodes and the identity map, checked by pool check-config: the optional tables [control], [[cluster]], [[node]] and [[identity]]; a cluster names its system identifier and expected_writer; config_version stays 1

Added (scope 003): tests for the four written walks of spec 0003 (clean startup, missing journal, conflicting role evidence, a backup restored after a promotion) and a model test over 8192 combinations of configuration, journal and observations
Added: fuzz target validate for pool_config::validate, 60 s via scripts/check.sh fuzz with cargo-fuzz 0.13.2; a command, not a required check
Added: pool check-config --config <PATH> [--format human|json], offline check; opens no socket, starts no thread, reads at most 1 MiB plus one byte
Added: scripts/check.sh <name>, one command per check, same as CI (fmt, clippy, test, deny, guards, docs, linux-build, plus fuzz, sbom, tools); all runs first six; exits 0/1/2/3
Added: first configuration contract (config_version = 1 plus reserved result_cache and automatic_promotion tables; asking for either is config.unsupported_capability, SEC-10)
Added: spec 0001 build notes, AC-1 to AC-13, five step build plan, verification record and independent review; Linux container build (AC-2) passed for aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
Added: exit status convention for POOL commands (0 success, 1 input rejected, 2 usage error, 3 could not finish)

Added: fixed finding codes (config.syntax, config.schema, config.missing_key, config.unsupported_version, config.too_large, config.not_utf8) with line and column; output from constant text, key names and positions only, so no secret appears (SEC-11)
Added: fifteen configuration fixtures and 134 automated tests on the workstation; 136 on Linux because two need /dev/full
Added: pool --help and pool --version
Added: JSON report (--format json), one line with a fixed field order, for scripts
Added: scripts/linux-build.sh runs the spec 0001 Linux build command; a guard fails when script and spec differ
Added: scripts/prove-checks.sh applies twenty eight deliberately wrong changes to a private copy and requires each named check to reject its case
Added: scripts/check.sh sbom writes a CycloneDX inventory to target/sbom/pool.cdx.json with cargo-cyclonedx 0.5.10
Added: three shared conventions in the engineering standards (configuration keys, exit status with command output, log event fields with redaction)
Added: scope 002 tools in the technology evaluation and agent guides for apps/pool and crates/pool-config
Added: Cargo workspace with the pool daemon binary and the pool-config library; Rust 1.100.0 pinned; unsafe code forbidden in both

Changed (scope 003): the shared conventions in the engineering standards now hold the rule for identifier and generation types, and the engineering standards and the repository structure name the third package
Unreleased, Added: the scope 001 workspace slice, the scope 002 required checks and the scope 003 control and session data model
Added: spec 0002 with 0002 AC-1 to AC-20, ADR 0002, verification record and independent review

Added (scope 003): a third workspace package, the pool-control library in crates/pool-control, holding the authority rules as plain functions: classify_startup, plan_bootstrap and writer_admission, which opens writes only when configuration, journal and a fresh observation name the same writer (0001 SC-8, R-19); nothing calls it yet

Added (scope 003): spec 0003 with acceptance criteria 0003 AC-1 to AC-16, ADR 0003, a verification record and an independent review; the record holds the workstation evidence, a Linux container build and the seven checks on the pull request
Added: .github/workflows/ci.yml with seven jobs on ubuntu-24.04-arm; runs on PR, push to main and daily; read access only, no secret, actions pinned by full commit hash

Changed (scope 003): the workspace has three packages; pool-repo-check workspace knows the new package and the one allowed dependency, pool-control on pool-config, and rule W4 now also fails when Cargo.lock holds a local package that is not a listed workspace member
Changed (scope 003): proving case 17 of scripts/prove-checks.sh now changes the first line of the scope 004 file, because feature 3 is no longer planned

Changed (scope 003): specs 0001 and 0002 carry dated notes that point at spec 0003: the first secret reference key (identity[].credential_file, read in scope 004), the fourth finding line, the new finding codes, the current workspace shape and the answer on how the guards learn the packages

Changed (scope 003): the word node now means a configured PostgreSQL server everywhere; backend keeps its glossary meaning, a connection POOL opens; the glossary rows Observation and Approved writer were reworded
Added: pool-repo-check in tools/repo-check (no dependencies, outside workspace): workspace, ci and docs guards; 198 tests

Added: deny.toml checked by cargo-deny 0.20.2 on product and fuzz lockfiles; licenses exactly Apache-2.0, MIT, Unicode-3.0 plus NCSA for libfuzzer-sys; advisories, unmaintained and unsound fail; none ignored (SEC-13)

Added (scope 003): a limit on validation time at the 1 MiB file limit: three made files of almost 1 MiB, one invalid with one finding per entry, each validate within 10 seconds in a debug build (0003 AC-15)

Added (scope 003): a check in writer_admission that a ready authority still belongs to the configuration it was confirmed with; a configuration without control.authority_id, or with another value, closes writes (0003 AC-16)
